parts.label: (ii)
parts.answer: Median; the mean is distorted by the very large value $768$, and no mode exists because all values differ.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Not mean because data skewed by one large value [B1; must identify 768 or “a very large number”; condone “outlier”]. Not mode because frequencies all the same [B1; indicates no mode, all data different/no repeats]. Median [B1 dependent on statements for mean and mode, even if incorrect/general]. SC if mean chosen: no mode because all values differ [SCB1]; median unsuitable because not all values used, e.g. not middle of range [SCB1]. Total 3.
